column4: cleat#2097/#2109. ci.yml's test-go matrix only installs a Rust toolchain for the "internal" package entry (and only wasm32-wasip1, not wasm32-unknown-unknown -- see build_rust.go's own comment on why `cleat build --target rust` needs the latter). The "commands" job (./cmd/...) provisions no Rust toolchain at all, so this test's cargo build hits a missing target and skips via its own t.Skipf rather than the earlier "cargo not available" t.Skip -- the GitHub-hosted runner image preinstalls cargo itself, just not this target. Same class as this file's sibling dialect-gated lines: a toolchain-gated test costs ONE skip in every job that does not install it. Measured: go test ./cmd/cleat/ -run TestRustExampleEntryPointResolutionLive -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly one, on a machine/job with cargo but no wasm32-unknown-unknown target.
